Quill

A notebook app
scenes.css: body{background:var(--primary)} .t{position:absolute;left:9vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-52%)} h1{margin:0;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.06em;font:700 26vmin var(--display);color:var(--text);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em} .jv-char{display:inline-block;transform:translateY(115%);animation:ink .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*70ms)} @keyframes ink{to{transform:none}} .rule{height:.7vmin;width:30vw;background:var(--secondary);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0);animation:draw .5s .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;margin:1vmin 0 2.6vmin} @keyframes draw{to{transform:scaleX(1)}} .sub{margin:0;font:400 4.6vmin var(--body);color:var(--text);opacity:0;animation:show .45s .85s ease-out both} @keyframes show{to{opacity:.9}}

scenes.html: Open it and start typing.
scenes.css: body{background:var(--primary)} .margin{position:absolute;left:7vw;top:0;bottom:0;width:.3vmin;background:var(--secondary);opacity:.5} .s2{position:absolute;left:10vw;top:16vmin;width:76vw} .line{margin:0;font:700 11.5vmin var(--display);color:var(--text);line-height:1.1} .jv-char{opacity:0;animation:type .01s steps(1) both;animation-delay:calc(80ms + var(--i)*42ms)} @keyframes type{to{opacity:1}} .next{margin:3vmin 0 0;height:11vmin} .caret{display:inline-block;width:1.4vmin;height:9.5vmin;background:var(--secondary);animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite} @keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}

scenes.css: body{background:var(--paper)} .s3{position:absolute;inset:0} .left{position:absolute;left:8vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:44vw} .search{border-bottom:.6vmin solid var(--ink);padding:0 0 1.6vmin;font:400 7vmin var(--body);color:var(--ink);height:8vmin;display:flex;align-items:flex-end} .q .jv-char{opacity:0;animation:type .01s steps(1) both;animation-delay:calc(250ms + var(--i)*75ms)} @keyframes type{to{opacity:1}} .bar{display:inline-block;width:.6vmin;height:6.5vmin;background:var(--ink);margin-left:.6vmin;margin-bottom:.4vmin} .hit{margin-top:3.2vmin;font:400 3.9vmin var(--body);color:var(--inkSoft);clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0);animation:reveal .55s 1050ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;white-space:nowrap} @keyframes reveal{to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}} .d{display:inline-block;width:7vmin;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700} mark{background:var(--secondary);color:var(--ink);padding:0 .12em} h2{position:absolute;left:58vw;right:6vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);margin:0;font:700 9.5vmin var(--display);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.04}

scenes.css: body{background:var(--primary)} .s4{position:absolute;inset:0} h2{position:absolute;left:8vw;top:18vmin;width:50vw;margin:0;font:700 8.6vmin var(--display);color:var(--text);line-height:1.08} .w{display:inline-block;clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0);animation:wipe .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both} .w2{animation-delay:.28s} @keyframes wipe{to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}} .days{position:absolute;left:8vw;right:8vw;bottom:14vmin;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none} .days li{font:400 4vmin var(--body);color:var(--text);padding:1.8vmin 0;border-top:.25vmin solid rgba(241,234,217,.22);opacity:0;transform:translateX(5vmin);animation:row .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both} .days li:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.7s} .days li:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.9s} .days li:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1.1s} .days li:nth-child(4){animation-delay:1.3s} .days b{display:inline-block;width:9vmin;color:var(--secondary);font-weight:700} @keyframes row{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

body{background:var(--secondary)} .s5{position:absolute;inset:0} .name{position:absolute;left:8vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-54%);font:700 24vmin var(--display);color:var(--ink);line-height:1} .slab{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:38vw;background:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:translateX(100%);animation:slab .6s .1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both} @keyframes slab{to{transform:none}} .cta{font:700 5.2vmin var(--body);color:var(--paper);border:.5vmin solid var(--paper);padding:2.2vmin 4vmin;opacity:0;animation:show .4s .6s ease-out both} @keyframes show{to{opacity:1}}
